title: TechOps Engineer III
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**TechOps III**
professional to join our Technology Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the availability, reliability, performance, and security of production systems. You will lead complex operational initiatives, automate infrastructure and operational processes, troubleshoot critical production issues, and collaborate with engineering teams to improve platform stability and scalability.
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong expertise in cloud platforms, infrastructure automation, monitoring, incident management, and DevOps practices, with the ability to mentor junior team members and drive operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and support mission-critical production environments with high availability and reliability.
* Monitor application, infrastructure, and platform health using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production incidents and perform root cause analysis (RCA).
* Develop automation scripts and workflows to reduce manual operational tasks.
* Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and configuration management best practices.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Security, and Product teams to improve deployment processes and operational readiness.
* Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response during critical outages.
* Drive continuous improvements in system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Maintain disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity processes.
* Ensure systems comply with security, governance, and compliance standards.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
* Mentor junior TechOps engineers and provide technical leadership during complex initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience in Technology Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, or DevOps.
* Strong experience administering Linux and/or Windows servers.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with container technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or ELK.
* Solid understanding of networking concepts, DNS, load balancing, VPNs, and firewalls.
* Experience with version control systems such as Git.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
* Knowledge of SRE principles and operational excellence practices.
* Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Kubernetes or container platform certifications.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent operational certification.
* Experience supporting SaaS or large-scale distributed systems.

**Core Competencies**

* Production Operations
* Incident Management
* Root Cause Analysis

Monitoring & Observability
  
  

* DevOps & CI/CD
* ITIL Best Practices
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Technical Leadership
* Process Improvement
* Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing

**Success Metrics**

* High production system uptime and availability.
* Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
* Increased operational automation and reduced manual effort.
* Successful delivery of infrastructure improvements.
* Timely resolution of production incidents.
* Improved platform performance and reliability.
* Positive stakeholder and customer satisfaction.
* High-quality documentation and operational readiness.

**Work Environment**

* Hybrid or remote work model, based on business needs.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for production support.
* Occasional after-hours support for planned maintenance or critical incidents.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Technical Account Engineer I
description:
**Technical Account Engineer - I**

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

**About the Role**

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

**What You Will Actually Do**

* **Own your named accounts technically.**
  Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.
* **Get customers using the platform extensively.**
  Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.
* **Craft success plans that can be measured.**
  Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.
* **See trouble coming.**
  Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.
* **Run the cadence.**
  Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.
* **Help the accounts grow.**
  Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.
* **Make the team better.**
  Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

**Where and When**

* This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.
* Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.
* You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.
* Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.
* A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.
* Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.
* A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

**The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See**

* Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).
* A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers’ lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.
* Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.
* Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.
* Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

* Work effectively in a global delivery environment, collaborating with teams and stakeholders across multiple geographies.

* Experience with PowerShell scripting for operational support or automation.
* Practical understanding of production/application support, including monitoring, incident investigation, service requests and ticket management.
* Understanding of ITIL principles and service management processes. ITIL certification is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Experience supporting business-critical applications in a production environment.

**Business And Industry Experience**

* Exposure to capital markets, investment management or financial services would be an advantage.

title: Sr IO Engineering Consultant - SCCM or MECM Admin and MS Intune
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
As an I&O Engineering Consultant or Senior I O Engineering Consultant, you will deliver reliable and secure device management services in a Dual UEM environment built on Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune. You will own day-to-day endpoint engineering and operational outcomes such as OS and patch compliance, client health, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint configuration. The role is execution-focused with solid troubleshooting depth and disciplined ITSM practices utilizing both on-premise server infrastructure as well as cloud services through Microsoft Entra. As necessary, you will routinely participate in major incident bridges/war rooms, ensuring service restoration within agreed SLAs and contributing to measurable MTTR reduction. You will also contribute to AI adoption by proposing and piloting practical ideations (e.g., ticket triage assist, automated log parsing, runbook generation) to improve reliability, speed, and user experience, while adhering to organizational security, privacy, and data handling standards.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Patching, Vulnerability Remediation & Compliance

+ Operate software update and patching operations via SCCM (ADRs, maintenance windows, deployment schedules, compliance reporting) and coordinate exception handling
+ Track and improve patch compliance posture across the endpoint estate; identify and remediate non-compliant devices; support compliance dashboards and executive reporting
+ Drive client health compliance. Monitor and remediate endpoint SCCM/Intune client health, enrollment success, policy/app deployment success, and content distribution health

* Platform Engineering & Operations, Application Support

+ Administer SCCM components (collections, boundaries, deployments, content distribution, client health monitoring, reporting)
+ Administer Intune capabilities (enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, app assignments, RBAC) and support coexistence with SCCM
+ Monitor platform health and availability: enrollment success, policy/app success rates, client health, content distribution health, and remediation backlogs
+ Drive device inventory accuracy and operational hygiene; perform routine health checks and standard validations

* Application Lifecycle, OS Servicing & Operations

+ Support SCCM OS deployment and servicing (OSD, Task Sequences, feature updates, in-place upgrades), driver/BIOS packaging coordination, and rollback plans
+ Execute post-deployment validation and remediation for failed installs, policy conflicts, and provisioning issues

* Troubleshooting, ITSM & War Rooms

+ Troubleshoot endpoint deployment and client issues using logs and diagnostics (e.g., AppEnforce/AppDiscovery, WUAHandler, CAS, CCMExec)
+ Work within ITSM processes (Incident/Problem/Change) including change documentation, risk assessment, and post-change validation
+ Participate in major incident war rooms/bridges; provide technical inputs, implement mitigations, and document restoration actions
+ Track and drive SLA adherence; contribute to MTTR reduction via faster triage, known error documentation, and repeat-incident prevention

* Automation & AI Adoption / Ideation

+ Create and maintain PowerShell-based operational automations (health checks, compliance reporting, remediation scripts)
+ Propose AI-assisted improvements (e.g., Copilot-assisted draft runbooks, KB articles, ticket summarization, and log pattern identification)
+ Pilot small-scale AI/automation ideations with measurable success criteria (time saved, reduced rework, improved compliance)
+ Ensure AI usage adheres to organizational security, privacy, and data handling policies (no sensitive data leakage)
+ Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation by streamlining workflows and automating repetitive tasks. Evaluate emerging trends to drive continuous improvement and strategic innovation.

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of hands-on administrative experience using SCCM
* 3+ years of hands-on administrative experience using Intune
* Operations, Health and Availability experience

+ Health monitoring and remediation: client health, enrollment success, policy/app deployment success, content distribution health
+ Service reliability ownership: stability, availability, and operational hygiene

* Patching and Vulnerability Operations experience

+ MECM patching operations: ADRs, deployment rings, maintenance windows, compliance reporting
+ Vulnerability remediation support: execute remediation plans and validate compliance within required timelines

* Automation and Scripting experience

+ PowerShell scripting for automation and remediation; familiarity with scheduled tasks and basic safe rollout practices
+ Ability to create repeatable runbooks and operational checklists

* ITSM and Operational Excellence

+ Experience working in war rooms and providing concise technical updates for rapid restoration
+ Working knowledge of Incident/Problem/Change management; ability to write clear change plans and validation steps
+ Ownership mindset for SLA adherence and MTTR reduction

* Proven Core Technical Skills (Primary)

+ Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM: 1+ years; administrative depth (profiles, Smart Groups, app distribution, compliance policies, device troubleshooting)
+ MECM/SCCM: application model, collections, deployments, boundaries, content distribution, client health, reporting
+ Microsoft Intune: enrollment methods, configuration/compliance policies, Win32 app deployment, troubleshooting, RBAC
+ Dual UEM operations: support coexistence, minimize policy conflicts, and ensure consistent end-user experience

* Proven AI Adoption and Continuous Improvement

+ Comfort using approved AI tools to accelerate documentation, analysis, and knowledge management
+ Ability to identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation or AI assistance and propose improvements

* Solid understanding of packaging and deployment of applications (MSI/EXE/MSIX/Win32) using SCCM/Intune using detection methods, dependencies, supersedence, and phased ring deployments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience
* ITIL Foundation, Microsoft endpoint-related certifications, Workspace ONE training/certification
* 2+ years of hands-on administrative experience with Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM (formerly AirWatch)

**Success Measures**

* Endpoint platform health and availability maintained with sustained reduction in unhealthy clients/devices
* Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation achieved within agreed windows; improved deployment success rates
* Reduced repeat incidents through better RCA documentation, known error articles, and proactive remediation

Join the Enterprise Technology Infrastructure Platform Services ( ETIPS ) team, driving innovation and reliability across core systems.
  
  
*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Specialist - Technology Services
description:
**Job Summary**
The DLP Security Analyst will support the day-to-day operation, administration, and enhancement of the enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) environment. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the role will assist with monitoring alerts, troubleshooting technical issues, maintaining policies and workflows, coordinating with vendors, and preparing clear operational documentation. The analyst will collaborate with IT Operations, Network and Infrastructure teams, Service Managers, Legal, Risk Management, and other stakeholders as required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor DLP alerts, perform initial analysis, document findings, and escalate incidents in accordance with established procedures.
* Create, configure, test, and fine-tune DLP policies, detection rules, exceptions, and workflows under appropriate guidance and change-control processes.
* Support incident response activities by collecting relevant information, following escalation paths, and coordinating with appropriate teams.
* Maintain accurate operational documentation, including standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, policy records, and activity reports.
* Communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, and vendors, and provide timely updates on issues, changes, and assigned activities.
* Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, documentation, knowledge management, and process improvement while following security and data-handling requirements.
* Other tasks as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience Requirements**

* Understanding of DLP concepts, information security principles, and incident handling.
* Familiarity with DLP administration activities such as alert monitoring, policy configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, patching, and reporting.
* Develop and fine-tune policies, rules, exceptions, and automated workflows.
* Familiar with DSPM (Data Security Posture Management) concepts.
* Hands-on experience with DLP and DSPM tools, particularly Forcepoint DLP and Varonis DSPM, will be considered an advantage.
* Familiarity with practical uses of AI and automation in DLP operations, documentation, and process improvement.
* Good verbal, written, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of information security concepts related to governance, risk, and compliance.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to research issues, follow procedures, and seek guidance when needed.
* Collaborative, detail-oriented, adaptable, and committed to maintaining confidentiality and professional integrity.

**Qualifications, Certifications, And Education Requirements**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
**Experience**
3–5 years of relevant experience in DLP, IT security operations, security monitoring, or technical support, with practical exposure to administering and supporting enterprise security technologies.
  
  

* Experience with alert review, ticketing tools, technical troubleshooting, or process documentation is beneficial.

**Preferred Certification**
Entry-level certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Security fundamentals, Microsoft SC - 400 or an equivalent information security certification are desirable but not mandatory.

title: Senior Server & Infrastructure Security Administrator
description:
**Company:**
ReBrand Gurus

**Location:**
Noida

**Experience:**
3–5+ years

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Join ReBrand Gurus**

ReBrand Gurus is a boutique creative technology agency working with businesses across website development, mobile applications, digital marketing, SEO and other digital solutions.

We manage multiple client websites and digital platforms, and we are looking for an experienced
**Senior Server & Infrastructure Security Administrator**
to take ownership of our hosting environments, server infrastructure, website security, and technical troubleshooting.

About the Role

We are looking for a technically strong professional who can keep our web infrastructure secure, stable, monitored, and recoverable.

This is not a regular WordPress developer or basic Server Administrator role. We need someone who understands server-level security, can investigate complex technical problems, and knows how to protect multiple websites from vulnerabilities, malware, server failures, and unauthorized access.

The ideal candidate will take responsibility for identifying potential risks, preventing avoidable downtime, investigating security incidents, and restoring services safely when unexpected problems occur.

**Your primary responsibility will be to protect ReBrand Gurus' web infrastructure and ensure that our websites remain secure, stable, and recoverable.**

Key Responsibilities1. Linux Server and Hosting Management

* Manage and maintain Linux servers, VPS environments, and website hosting platforms such as Hostinger, hPanel, cPanel, and similar services.
* Monitor server health, CPU/RAM usage, disk space, uptime, resource consumption, and website performance.
* Investigate and resolve server-level problems affecting one or multiple websites.
* Manage PHP versions, MySQL/MariaDB databases, cron jobs, file permissions, and server configurations.
* Work confidently with SSH and the Linux command line for server administration and troubleshooting.
* Perform routine server maintenance, software updates, security patches, and configuration reviews.
* Handle website migrations, hosting migrations, and server configuration changes safely.
* Identify infrastructure weaknesses and recommend improvements to server stability and security.

2. Website and WordPress Administration

* Manage and troubleshoot multiple WordPress websites hosted across different environments.
* Diagnose plugin, theme, PHP, database, and compatibility issues.
* Resolve website downtime, HTTP 500/502/503 errors, database connection failures, and other server-related website problems.
* Perform WordPress core, plugin, and theme updates safely.
* Troubleshoot WooCommerce websites and related technical issues.
* Maintain staging and production environments.
* Investigate website performance issues and implement appropriate solutions.
* Work with developers to resolve application-level problems when required.

3. Server Security and Malware Prevention

This is one of the most important responsibilities of the role.

* Monitor websites and servers for malware, suspicious activity, unauthorized access, and security vulnerabilities.
* Investigate malware infections, compromised websites, suspicious PHP files, malicious scripts, and hidden backdoors.
* Identify possible entry points and determine how a security compromise occurred.
* Investigate compromised administrator accounts, vulnerable plugins, outdated software, and insecure server configurations.
* Implement server hardening, firewall rules, access controls, security patches, and other appropriate protective measures.
* Configure and manage Cloudflare security features, WAF, and other relevant security tools.
* Review server and website logs to identify suspicious activity and potential threats.
* Check related websites and accounts when a shared server or hosting environment may have been compromised.
* Verify that security incidents have been properly resolved and monitor for signs of reinfection.
* Maintain practical security procedures to reduce the risk of future incidents.

**Important:**
Removing infected files alone is not sufficient to resolve every malware incident. The candidate must understand how to investigate the original entry point, identify possible backdoors, assess the wider hosting environment, and prevent the same vulnerability from being exploited again.

4. Backup and Disaster Recovery

* Configure and maintain automated website, database, and server backups.
* Maintain appropriate backup retention and access controls.
* Ensure backups are stored securely and independently of the primary environment wherever practical.
* Regularly verify backup integrity and test website and database restoration.
* Develop and maintain recovery procedures for server failures, malware incidents, accidental deletions, and data loss.
* Restore affected websites and services from trusted backups when required.
* Identify recovery risks and recommend measures to minimize downtime and data loss.

The goal is to ensure that a website or server failure does not automatically require rebuilding websites from scratch.

5. Domains, DNS, SSL, and Cloudflare

* Manage domain configurations, nameservers, DNS records, and domain transfers.
* Troubleshoot A records, CNAME, MX, and TXT records.
* Configure and troubleshoot SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records.
* Manage SSL certificates, HTTPS configuration, and renewals.
* Resolve DNS propagation, incorrect domain pointing, and website connectivity issues.
* Manage Cloudflare DNS, CDN settings, and security configurations.
* Monitor domain, hosting, and SSL expiry dates to prevent avoidable service disruptions.

6. Business Email Administration

Manage and troubleshoot business email services, including:

* Google Workspace
* Microsoft 365
* Hostinger Email
* Zoho Mail
* SMTP configurations

The candidate should be able to diagnose and resolve:

* Emails not being sent or received.
* Emails bouncing or being delivered to spam.
* Incorrect MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configurations.
* SMTP authentication and connection failures.
* Domain-related email delivery issues.
* Email account configuration and security problems.

7. Shopify and Third-Party Integrations

* Troubleshoot Shopify stores, themes, apps, and integrations.
* Manage domain connections and DNS configurations.
* Investigate website connectivity, email, and third-party integration issues.
* Coordinate with developers or platform support when specialized assistance is required.

8. Proactive Monitoring and Technical Maintenance

* Set up and maintain website uptime, server performance, and security monitoring.
* Configure alerts for downtime, unusual resource consumption, suspicious activity, and backup failures.
* Identify potential issues before they develop into major disruptions.
* Conduct routine reviews of server configurations, access permissions, software updates, and security settings.
* Maintain documentation of servers, hosting accounts, websites, domains, and technical configurations.
* Document incidents, root causes, resolutions, and preventive measures.
* Recommend practical improvements to infrastructure security, reliability, and performance.

**Required Technical Skills**

Candidates must have practical, hands-on experience with:

* Linux server administration and command-line troubleshooting.
* Hostinger/hPanel, cPanel, or equivalent hosting environments.
* VPS and shared hosting management.
* WordPress administration and technical troubleshooting.
* PHP and MySQL/MariaDB.
* SSH, FTP/SFTP, and server access management.
* DNS management, nameservers, and DNS records.
* SSL certificates and HTTPS troubleshooting.
* Cloudflare and website security.
* Malware investigation, backdoor detection, and remediation.
* Server hardening, vulnerability remediation, and security monitoring.
* Automated backups, restoration, and disaster recovery.
* Business email administration and email authentication protocols.
* Root-cause analysis and incident resolution.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Nginx and Apache configuration.
* cPanel/WHM and CloudLinux.
* WP-CLI and Git.
* AWS, DigitalOcean, or similar cloud platforms.
* Redis and website caching systems.
* Bash or Python scripting for automation.
* Security scanning tools and server monitoring solutions.
* DDoS protection, CDN management, and advanced firewall configurations.

**What We Expect From You**

We are looking for someone who:

* Thinks like a system administrator and security professional, not just a website developer.
* Can independently investigate and resolve infrastructure-related problems.
* Understands how server-level vulnerabilities can affect multiple websites.
* Takes ownership of technical issues from investigation to resolution.
* Follows a systematic troubleshooting process instead of making random changes.
* Prioritizes preventive maintenance and long-term solutions.
* Understands the importance of secure backups and tested recovery procedures.
* Communicates technical problems clearly to management and non-technical team members.
* Documents important changes, incidents, and resolutions.
* Takes responsibility for protecting client websites, business emails, and digital assets.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will become the
**technical guardian of ReBrand Gurus' web infrastructure**
.

When a website goes down, an email stops working, a domain develops DNS issues, a server becomes unstable, or malware is detected, you will investigate the problem, identify its root cause, and take ownership of the resolution.

You will also be responsible for strengthening our infrastructure, identifying risks before they cause disruption, maintaining reliable recovery options, and reducing the likelihood and impact of future security incidents.

Our expectation is not simply to fix problems when they occur, but to build and maintain an infrastructure that is secure, resilient, and prepared for unexpected failures.

**Apply Now**

If you have strong hands-on experience in Linux server administration, website security, WordPress troubleshooting, and infrastructure management, we would love to hear from you.

**Send your resume to:**
hr@rebrandgurus.us.

Application for Senior Server & Infrastructure Security Administrator

description:

Role and Responsibilities:
  
  

* Malware & Phishing Defense: Manage Cisco Talos threat intelligence feeds to block spam, viruses, and malicious attachments. Utilize Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) for file reputation and sandboxing.
* Connection & Reputation Filtering: Adjust IP, domain, and sender reputation parameters to drop malicious connection attempts.
* Outbreak Filters: Configure real-time outbreak rules to protect against new, zero-day threat campaigns
* Content Filtering: Create custom message filters to block specific file types, strip harmful scripts, or enforce company-wide disclaimers
* Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Set up policies to scan outbound traffic and prevent the leakage of sensitive data (e.g., PII, financial information)
* Domain Security: Enforce Sender Policy Framework (SPF), DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM), and Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance (DMARC) to prevent domain spoofing
* Message Tracking & Analytics: Track message dispositions, investigate delivery failures, and generate executive reports on threat trends using centralized management dashboards
* Quarantine Management: Review, release, or delete quarantined emails, and address false positives to prevent business disruption
* Monitor Sender Ecosystem: Regularly review Valimail Monitor or Enforce reports to identify and track all third-party services sending emails on your domain's behalf
* Monitoring & Visibility: Review the Valimail Monitor dashboard to identify unapproved third-party services and unauthorized IP addresses
* Monitor system performance, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions for email security incidents.
* Manage configuration, upgrades, and patching for Cisco Secure Email and Valimail environments.
* Collaborate with IT security, compliance, and infrastructure teams to maintain optimal email security posture.
* Develop and update technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Participate in security audits, support incident response activities, and assist with email threat investigations.
* Plan and Coordinate with the vendor for regular health checks and implement vendor recommendations
* Provides deep subject matter expertise, advice and program delivery.
* Support 24x7 steady state operations-Flexible working in US business hours for all required work done and during weekends.

* Proficiency in email protocols (SMTP, IMAP, POP3) and email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
* Solid understanding of networking, firewalls, and security best practices.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills

title: FTE Helpdesk Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
Iron Systems is an innovative, customer-focused provider of custom-built computing infrastructure platforms such as network servers, storage, OEM/ODM appliances & embedded systems. For more than 15 years, customer have trusted us for our innovative problem solving combined with holistic design, engineering, manufacturing, logistic and global support services.
**B. Field Engineer Lifecycle & Operational Readiness**
**C. Serviceo Portal & Workforce Process Support**
**D. Team Leadership & Performance Management**
**E. SLA, Quality & Compliance Management**
**F. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination**
**G. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**
**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Position Summary The Manager – FTE Helpdesk is responsible for leading the global FTE Helpdesk operations supporting Field Engineers and other designated workforce categories across Iron Systems' customer programs.
* Key Responsibilities
* FTE Helpdesk Operations & Service Delivery
* Lead and manage day-to-day FTE Helpdesk operations supporting Field Engineers across multiple geographies, customer programs, and employment categories.
* Ensure timely resolution of worker queries related to onboarding readiness, access and credentials, Serviceo usage, timesheets, attendance, work assignments, shift-related concerns, and workforce administration.
* Manage the Helpdesk's shared mailbox, ticket queues, communication channels, and other designated support platforms.
* Ensure consistent, professional, and documented communication with Field Engineers, Program Managers, and internal stakeholders.
* Monitor open, pending, overdue, and escalated cases to ensure timely closure and prevent operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with Internal and Recruitment teams to ensure Field Engineers are appropriately onboarded and operationally ready before deployment, as applicable to the program.
* Support the creation and activation of Internal Service Contracts and coordinate the provisioning of required credentials, accounts, and access with relevant IT and operations teams.
* Ensure required worker information, program details, payroll or employment category, job order references, and other mandatory details are accurately communicated to the appropriate teams.
* Support workforce transitions, program changes, worker transfers, and offboarding activities through defined processes.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve deployment blockers, missing information, access issues, and other readiness gaps.
* Maintain appropriate records of support requests and lifecycle-related actions to support operational visibility and auditability.
* Oversee Helpdesk support for the Serviceo portal and related workforce management workflows.
* Ensure Field Engineers receive appropriate assistance with check-in/check-out, timesheet submissions, deliverable uploads, messaging, and other portal-related activities.
* Coordinate resolution of portal access, technical, data, and workflow issues with the relevant technical or application support teams.
* Promote correct portal usage and adherence to prescribed operational procedures.
* Identify recurring issues and collaborate with IT, and Program Management teams to improve user experience and reduce avoidable support requests.
* Monitor portal-related compliance and adoption indicators, including Portal Collaboration Rating (PCR), where applicable.
* Lead, coach, and develop the FTE Helpdesk team, ensuring clear accountability, appropriate workload distribution, and consistent service quality.
* Define individual and team performance goals aligned with operational requirements and departmental objectives.
* Establish shift coverage, work allocation, backup arrangements, and escalation ownership to ensure business continuity across supported time zones.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, quality checks, coaching sessions, and team meetings.
* Develop team capability through training on internal systems, workforce policies, customer-specific processes, communication standards, and escalation protocols.
* Foster a service-oriented culture focused on ownership, responsiveness, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
* Define, monitor, and report on Helpdesk SLAs, including first response time, resolution time, ticket backlog, escalation turnaround, and case quality.
* Ensure all cases are recorded, categorized, tracked, and closed with appropriate documentation.
* Conduct periodic audits of tickets, worker records, communications, and process adherence.
* Ensure support activities follow company policies, customer-specific requirements, data privacy standards, information security controls, and applicable local regulations.
* Act as the primary operational escalation point for complex FTE Helpdesk issues.
* Work closely with Internal Team, Recruitment, Program Management, FTE Shift Managers/Leads, IT, Finance, Payroll, and other relevant functions.
* Coordinate with Program Managers and Project Owners to resolve worker assignment, shift, attendance, service delivery, and administrative issues.
* Ensure relevant stakeholders receive timely updates on critical issues, recurring blockers, and cases requiring management intervention.
* Facilitate effective handoffs between teams and ensure clear ownership of actions until resolution.
* Support customer-specific operational requirements through coordination with internal stakeholders, following established authorization and communication protocols.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports covering ticket volumes, resolution performance, backlog, escalations, SLA adherence, quality, and recurring issue categories.
* Analyse trends to identify root causes, recurring process gaps, and opportunities to reduce ticket volumes and resolution times.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, knowledge-base articles, FAQs, communication templates, and escalation matrices.
* Drive process standardization and automation of repetitive support activities wherever feasible.
* Provide data-driven recommendations to Team leadership for improved service delivery, workforce experience, productivity, and operational scalability.
* Support internal reviews, compliance audits, management reporting, and other departmental initiatives as required.

Performance will be measured against agreed targets, supported by accurate reporting and periodic.
**5. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Qualifications & Experience
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Operations Management, or a related discipline.
* Typically, 6–10 years of experience in Helpdesk Operations, HR Operations, Workforce Operations, Service Delivery, or related support functions.
* At least 2–4 years of experience in a team leadership or people management role.
* Experience managing support operations for a distributed, deskless, mobile, or field-based workforce is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting global teams, multiple time zones, customer programs, or geographically distributed operations is an advantage.
* Prior experience with ticketing systems, workforce management platforms, HRIS applications, service portals, and operational reporting tools is desirable.
* Strong operational management, team leadership, and people development skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-volume, SLA-driven support environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools; familiarity with dashboards and data analysis is preferred.
* Working knowledge of ticketing systems, HRIS platforms, workforce management tools, and service delivery processes.
* Strong process documentation, SOP development, and quality assurance capabilities.
* High standards of confidentiality, data accuracy, accountability, and professional conduct.
* Ability to work with global stakeholders and support operational requirements across different time zones.

description:
**About Signify**
Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.
  
  
At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.
  
  
Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**More about the role**
The
**Site support engineer**
provides hands-on technical support to users, systems, and IT infrastructure at a company location. This role is responsible for troubleshooting hardware, software, network, printer, meeting room, and end-user technology issues. The Onsite Support Engineer acts as the local IT contact for employees and works closely with remote service desk, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  

* Provide face-to-face technical support for employees at the office or client site.
* Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, scanners, docking stations, monitors, and peripherals.
* Install, configure, maintain, and replace IT hardware and software.
* Support Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, VPN, email, collaboration tools, and business applications.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, including Wi-Fi, LAN, VPN, and basic switching problems.
* Assist with user onboarding, offboarding, device setup, account access, and equipment handover.
* Support meeting rooms, video conferencing systems, projectors, Teams/Zoom rooms, and AV equipment.
* Escalate complex issues to infrastructure, network, security, or application teams when required.
* Maintain accurate ticket updates, asset records, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.
* Manage local IT inventory, including laptops, accessories, spare equipment, and consumables.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs, warranty claims, and service visits.
* Support IT projects such as office moves, device refreshes, software rollouts, and network upgrades.
* Follow IT security policies, access control procedures, and data protection standards.
* Provide excellent customer service and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical users.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Experience in onsite IT support, desktop support, field support, or service desk support.
* Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems; macOS experience is a plus.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and common office applications.
* Good understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, printers, mobile devices, and basic networking.
* Ability to troubleshoot Wi-Fi, LAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and connectivity issues.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Jira, Freshservice, Zendesk, or similar.
* Strong communication, customer service, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple support requests.
* Good documentation and follow-up skills.
* Update asset ownership, location, status, warranty, serial number, and configuration details.
* Coordinate hardware repairs, warranty claims, replacements, and vendor returns.
* Support secure disposal, recycling, resale, or destruction of retired equipment.
* Experience maintaining asset records in ITSM, CMDB
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record keeping.

**Key Competencies**

* Customer-focused mindset
* Strong troubleshooting ability
* Clear communication
* Patience and professionalism
* Attention to detail
* Ownership and follow-through
* Ability to work under pressure
* Good time management

**Preferred Certifications**

* Experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, SCCM, or endpoint management tools.
* Experience with asset management and IT inventory processes.
* Knowledge of ITIL service management practices.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity controls, MFA, endpoint protection, and patching.
* Experience supporting meeting room and AV systems.
* Ability to support VIP users or executive-level stakeholders.

**Common Tools and Technologies**

* Windows, macOS, iOS, Android
* Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint
* Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
* Microsoft Intune, SCCM
* ServiceNow
* VPN clients, Wi-Fi tools, remote support tools
* Printers, scanners, meeting room systems, AV equipment

**Everything we’ll do for you**
You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
  
  
Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: System Analyst
description:
**Job Description - System Analyst**

  
  

**About Rightsline:**

  
  

At Rightsline, we are redefining how the global media and entertainment industry manages and monetizes intellectual property. Since 2012, Rightsline has been trusted by some of the world’s most influential studios, broadcasters, and content owners to simplify the complex world of rights and royalties through powerful, intelligent technology.

  
  

Our cloud-based, fully integrated platform provides a single source of truth for managing rights, royalties, contracts, and financial workflows across markets, territories, and distribution channels. By bringing together data, automation, and collaboration in one configurable ecosystem, we enable organizations to unlock the full value of their content portfolios while operating with greater transparency, efficiency, and control.

  
  

At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide.

  
  

Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. If you are passionate about building impactful technology and working alongside talented global teams, Rightsline offers the platform to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful difference.

  
  

**What You Will Own:**

  

  
* Dedicated Support ticket management - includes first level response (Help Desk/Zendesk), triage, troubleshooting and resolution management and root cause analysis.
  
* Coordination and communication with the client on close calendar and outages.
  
* Coordinate environment preparation steps ahead of and after Expense/ Statement runs (db activities, sizing up environment, distribution of data).
  
* Import and COM Management including data analysis and error resolution.
  
* Execute, monitor, and support Calculation and Statement Runs against performance benchmarks.
  
* Trigger on call notification to resolve performance issues over weekend runs.
  
* Attend twice weekly stand up with client (1 tech call and 1 business user call)
  
* Attendance at required internal meetings
  
* Coverage Hours: Coverage during the US workday in Pacific Time Zone. Sometimes, weekends.
  
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams
  
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks
  

  
  
  

**What You Bring:**

  

  
* Undergraduate degree is mandatory
  
* 5+ years of experience is mandatory
  
* 2-3 years of experience in Royalties
  
* Experience in system administration, down time activity reporting
  
* Strong communication skills and ability to break down complex problems into manageable parts
  
* Experience in stakeholder management of international client
  
* Good grasp of data analysis, manipulation
  
* Strong understanding of Excel, Word, Powerpoint
  
* Attend stand up calls with client & internal for business and technical follows ups and resolution
  
* Experience in ticketing tools of Helpdesk
  
* Trigger on call notification to resolve performance issues over weekend runs
  
* Meet KPIs on a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis
  
* Weekend availability will be required for certain days
  

  
  

**Work Environment & Expectations:**

  

  
* Noida/NCR based
  
* Demonstrates flexibility to work in required shifts.
  
* Compliance with security and remote working policies
  

  
  

**Compensation & Growth:**

  

Competitive compensation aligned to market standards with strong career growth opportunities.

  
  

**Life at Rightsline India:**

  

At our India operations, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, accountability, and innovation. We believe in empowering our teams to take ownership, drive impact, and contribute meaningfully to global success.
  
  
  
 We offer a structured yet flexible work environment that balances performance with employee well-being. Our benefits framework for India includes:

  

  
* Provident Fund, Gratuity, and all statutory benefits in compliance with applicable Indian labour laws
  
* Comprehensive Group Medical Insurance covering employees and their eligible dependents
  
* Group Personal Accident Insurance for enhanced financial security
  
* In-office meal benefits, including sponsored breakfast, lunch, and evening snacks
  
* Hybrid work model with clearly defined collaboration days
  
* Flexible working hours, role-dependent
  
* Structured and transparent leave policy
  
* Career growth and advancement opportunities within a rapidly scaling global SaaS organization
  
* Continuous learning, upskilling, and leadership development support
  
* Quarterly employee engagement initiatives, along with celebrations and recognition programs
  

  
  
  

You will work alongside a globally connected team with strong leadership support and collaborative cross-functional exposure. We encourage proactive thinking, ownership, and initiative—ideas are welcomed, and execution is supported. As a people-first organization, we are committed to building a high-performance culture where growth, accountability, and innovation go hand in hand.

  
  

**Hiring Process:**

  

  
* HR Screening
  
* Technical / Functional Interview
  
* Assessment (As applicable)
  
* Leadership Round
  
* Offer Rollout
  

  
  

**Information Security & Compliance Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Adhere to ISMS policies and procedures
  
* Protect confidential and customer data
  
* Report security incidents
  
* Participate in compliance trainings and audits
  

  
  

**Data Privacy & Confidentiality:**

  

Employees must ensure proper handling of sensitive data in line with company policies and applicable laws.

  
  

**Access & Control Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Follow role-based access control principles
  
* Safeguard credentials
  
* Ensure authorized system usage
  

  
  

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

  

Rightsline is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

  
  

**Disclaimer:**

title: IT Service Management Lead
description:
Role: IT Service Management Lead

Preferred Experience Range: 8 to 10 years’ experience in IT Service Management and service delivery

Location: Delhi NCR/ Noida

**Skill Set:**

8-10 years of experience in end-to-end IT Service Management, including ownership of Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Request and Knowledge Management processes.

Proven experience leading operations, service governance, continual service improvement, and cross-functional delivery teams.

Strong understanding of Helpdesk practices, service management tools, computer systems, mobile devices and enterprise technology products.

Strong leadership, analytical and problem solving abilities,with effective cross team and vendor collaboration.

Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to influence technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors and senior leadership.

**Job Description / Responsibilities:**

Service Management Leadership

Lead end to end IT Service Management operations and ensure consistent delivery against agreed service levels and business priorities.

Provide leadership for major incidents, ensuring rapid assessment, prioritization, escalation, coordination and restoration of services.

Act as the senior point of contact for service critical matters and drive clear ownership across resolver groups.

Provide timely, accurate and audience appropriate updates to stakeholders including senior leadership.

Lead service reviews, major incident calls and post incident reviews, ensuring actions are tracked to closure.

Problem Management and Reporting

Own post- ncident reviews and ensure robust root cause analysis, corrective actions and long term preventive measures are completed.

Develop and review service performance reports, identify trends and risks and provide actionable recommendations.

Governance and Continual Improvement

Ensure adherence to aligned Incident, Problem, Change, Request and Knowledge Management processes.

Identify and deliver process improvements, automation opportunities and best practices that improve service quality and customer experience.

Partner with technical teams, vendors and business units to manage service risks, dependencies and escalations.

Coach team members, strengthen operational capability and coordinate with process owners to deliver sustainable service improvements.

**Responsibilities**

Incident Coordination:

Service Management Leadership:

Lead operations and major incidents from detection through service restoration and formal closure.

Ensure effective prioritization, escalation, resource coordination and adherence to agreed service levels.

Act as the senior point of contact for major incidents and service critical escalations.

Provide clear and timely communications to business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors and senior leadership.

Chair service reviews and post incident reviews with clear actions, owners, and closure tracking.

Problem Management and Reporting:

Drive root cause analysis, trend reviews, corrective actions and proactive problem management to reduce repeat incidents.

Maintain service performance reporting and document lessons learned, risks and preventive measures.

Governance and Continual Improvement:

Ensure compliance processes, controls, service levels and operational governance requirements.

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

description:
OnVUE Technical Support Coordinator (Advanced Associate)

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We’re a place where talented people with different viewpoints can have their voices valued and heard and we’re intentionally building a culture of belonging designed to attract and promote innovative, and skilled people, where everyone has the opportunity to make progress in their careers.

  
  

Your Opportunity

  
  

Join the Pearson operations team where we are dedicated to helping support candidates and clients throughout their certification testing process. The OnVUE Tech Support Team is an escalation point for our global testing candidates who may experience technical issues during the OnVUE exam process. As an Advanced Associate, you will focus on both live troubleshooting and post-issue research within the Pearson VUE case management system. If you are looking to work with a company that cares about its employees, including the importance of work-life balance, takes ownership of customer satisfaction, and cultivates an environment that integrates our Pearson values into everything we do – this is the place for you.

  
  

This is a candidate-facing role, where our coordinators will personally connect with test takers to offer support, guidance, and reassurance while walking customers through basic troubleshooting steps. Like every department within Pearson, our work goes beyond just delivering exams and focuses on our ability to allow learners to flourish. We are looking for team members who are ready and able to deliver a first-class level of customer service to our candidates and clients through skills we will help sharpen and grow. Our teams focus heavily on the importance of empathy and responding to candidate concerns – we don’t shy away from real-time feedback and consistent conversations with staff to ensure we never lose sight of our overall team, department, and company goals.

  

  
* **Title:**
  Advanced Associate
  
  
* **Location:**
  We are a global company and department, with team members are based in Bloomington, Minnesota and Noida, India. This position is based in Noida, India.
  
  
* **Hours:**
  You will be working a regular full-time position - working a 40-hour shift each week. We are hiring available shifts which will include hours in the afternoon/evening and/or weekends. For example, Sunday - Thursday, Saturday - Wednesday, Thursday - Monday or Tuesday - Saturday. Subject to change based on business needs.
  
  
* **New Hire Training:**
  During your first few weeks of onboarding, you’ll be asked to adhere to a training schedule that allows our teams to show you the ropes and create a foundation of required knowledge you’ll use throughout your career with Pearson.
  

  

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  
  

Technical Support and Troubleshooting

  

  
* Respond to candidate issues by analyzing the situation and performing necessary and appropriate actions to reach a resolution by using internal processes and critical thinking skills.
  
  
* Actively demonstrate the application of concepts and guidelines.
  
  
* Using an internal case management system to complete tasks and find best solutions for candidates while adhering and upholding client policies and internal procedures.
  
  
* Collect essential and relevant information to highlight trends, sharing findings with internal stakeholders to drive solutioning.
  
  
* Follow through on commitments and take responsibility for results, effectively prioritizing tasks. Identify and proposes solutions for barriers to leadership.
  

  

Deliver first-class customer service

  

  
* Understands the expectations of a test taker and able to adapt your communication style to meet the needs of a conversation while delivering service that exceeds customer’s needs within department guidelines.
  
  
* Effective verbal and written communication skills. Provide clear and concise directions to live candidates while troubleshooting, and/or explaining policies and/or testing procedures.
  
  
* Anticipate candidate needs, identifies, and resolves issues that impact the delivery of quality service.
  
  
* Use active listening to understand the candidate's concerns, demonstrating comprehension of the issue through the use of asking probing questions, providing supportive directions, and empathetic reassurance during high-stress situations.
  
  
* Ability to research, analyze, interpret, and document candidate interactions.
  
  
* Exhibits a positive can-do attitude and approach to tasks; meets new challenges and changes with an open mind; demonstrates commitment to the role and supporting a candidate.
  

  

Background Requirements

  
  

Education and Experience

  

  
* Minimum High School Diploma or equivalent
  
  
* Customer service experience preferred
  
  
* Basic technical troubleshooting experience preferred
  

  

Key characteristics we are looking for

  

  
* Passion for customer service and find joy in helping others succeed.
  
  
* Has a patient, positive, compassionate, and friendly demeanor.
  
  
* Thrive working with a team and technology.
  
  
* Eagerness to learn and willing to adapt to situations as business needs change and demand for service grows.
  
  
* Proficient standard technology including Windows, Microsoft 360 OneDrive, Excel, Word, and other related applications.
  
  
* Conflict management skills; diplomatic and sees feedback as an opportunity for growth.
  
  
* Time management skills; can quickly and effectively adapt to changes.
  
  
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and overcome objections.
  
  
* Strong attention to detail.
  
  
* Willing and able to work assigned shifts, flexible work arrangements and time off may be limited during specific times due to business demands. All overtime must be approved in advance.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

**Insurity’s Next Cloud Operations Analyst**

You'll work closely with engineers, and stakeholders using Jira to keep operational projects moving.
  
  
This role suits a detail-oriented, self-starting coordinator who juggles multiple tickets and projects at once and communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. You'll fit well on our Cloud AppOps team if you bring strong ITSM instincts and the flexibility to reprioritize in a fast-moving operations environment.
  
  
What Our
**Cloud Operations Analyst**
Will Do
  
  

* Maintain ownership and accountability for service management assigned tasks and small projects.
* Document requirements, define scope and objectives for service management tasks and projects.
* Help breakdown service delivery requirements and delivery problems (incidents, problems, requests, and changes) into manageable parts and assess risk throughout the implementation.

* Track and bring task impediments, issues, and onboarding blockers to closure.
* Provide status reports to stakeholders.

* Maintain and enhance service management operational procedures and runbooks.
* Facilitate operational areas such as but not limited to: Change Control, Incident Management, Problem Management, Request Management, FinOps and Disaster Recovery Exercises.
* Help manage internal team member and external vendor relationships necessary for a successful project delivery.
* Coordinate assigned operational projects, including meeting cadence, action tracking, and status reporting through closure.
* Collaborate with peers on best practices.
* Stay up to date on industry and job-related trends and best practices, including reading relevant publications, articles, blogs, etc.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Incident Management**

* Prepare and present root cause analysis and incident reports.
* Coordinate postmortem activities.

**Change Management**

* Coordinate weekly change control activities and approval process.
* Participate in the implementation of strategies to optimize operations.

**FinOps**

* Support incident, RCA, and credits review activities alongside senior leadership, ensuring the accuracy of related data.
* Map quarterly SLA credits owed to different clients based on outages across different products, in coordination with senior leadership.

**Who We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Perform the following skills at a proficient level:

+ Analytical and critical thinking
+ Written and oral English communication
+ Time management including work planning, prioritization, and organization
+ Ability to handle multiple priorities or tasks
+ Self-starter and quick learner
+ Detail-oriented
+ Active listener
+ Ability to collaborate and work autonomously
+ Flexible and adaptable
+ Service coordination and stakeholder follow-up
+ Incident triage and prioritization
+ Problem and change management discipline
+ Reporting accuracy and process adherence

  
  

* Minimum 2 years' experience in service management, operational coordination, incident / problem / change management, or project coordination within a Cloud environment.
* Bachelor's degree in related field (equivalent work experience may be considered).
* Proficient knowledge and experience with:

+ MS Office, notably MS Excel, MS Word, and MS Outlook
+ Agile project management methodology
+ Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence) with strong workflow discipline for incidents, problems, requests, and changes
+ ITSM-style ticketing, reporting, and dashboarding practices

* Travel required - 0-25%

title: Application Support & Maintenance - IBM Tivoli
description:
**Job Description:**
**Role:**
LogicMonitor Support Engineer / Monitoring Platform Engineer
  
  
**Support Level:**
L2/L3

8-10
  
  
**Experience:**
Typically 5–10 years
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide L2/L3 production support and administration for the LogicMonitor monitoring platform.
* Monitor and maintain LogicMonitor Collectors, resources, DataSources, alerts, dashboards, and integrations.
* Perform onboarding and configuration of servers, network devices, applications, databases, and cloud resources into LogicMonitor.
* Configure and troubleshoot LogicMonitor Collectors, including collector connectivity, performance, upgrades, and failover.
* Create, configure, and maintain DataSources, PropertySources, EventSources, ConfigSources, and monitoring templates.
* Configure and tune alert thresholds, escalation chains, notification rules, and alert routing.
* Troubleshoot missing monitoring data, false alerts, collector failures, connectivity issues, and device discovery problems.
* Perform monitoring and troubleshooting using protocols and technologies such as SNMP, WMI, SSH, REST APIs, JDBC, HTTP/HTTPS, and Syslog.
* Support monitoring across Windows, Linux/Unix, network, database, middleware, and cloud environments.
* Build and maintain LogicMonitor dashboards and reports for infrastructure health, availability, capacity, and performance.
* Investigate production incidents and perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring monitoring or platform issues.
* Integrate LogicMonitor with ITSM and notification platforms such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, email, PagerDuty, or similar tools.
* Support ServiceNow incident creation and alert-to-ticket integration, including troubleshooting duplicate or missing incidents.
* Perform monitoring configuration changes through established change management processes.
* Support LogicMonitor platform upgrades, Collector upgrades, maintenance activities, and monitoring improvements.
* Develop or modify monitoring logic using Groovy, PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or other scripting technologies as required.
* Perform alert optimization and noise reduction by reviewing thresholds, duplicate alerts, dependencies, and monitoring configurations.
* Work with application, infrastructure, network, database, cloud, and vendor teams to troubleshoot complex monitoring issues.
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, monitoring standards, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Participate in incident, problem, change, and service-request management using ITSM tools.
* Provide production support during critical incidents and participate in on-call support when required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with LogicMonitor administration and support.
* Good understanding of:

+ LogicMonitor Collectors
+ Resources and Resource Groups
+ DataSources
+ PropertySources
+ EventSources
+ ConfigSources
+ Alert thresholds
+ Escalation chains
+ Dashboards and reports
+ Device/resource discovery

* Good administration/troubleshooting knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows Server.
* Understanding of network devices, firewalls, load balancers, storage, databases, and middleware monitoring.
* Experience troubleshooting CPU, memory, disk, filesystem, network, process, service, and application availability issues.
* Knowledge of at least one cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with scripting using Groovy, PowerShell, Python, Bash/Shell, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of ServiceNow incident/change/problem management processes.
* Experience with monitoring integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, email, and ITSM tools.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience developing or customizing LogicModules.
* Experience with dynamic resource discovery and automated monitoring onboarding.
* Knowledge of APM, observability, infrastructure monitoring, and event management concepts.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Datadog, AppDynamics, Nagios, IBM Tivoli, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, capacity management, and monitoring architecture.
* Experience with automation and monitoring-as-code concepts.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and enterprise production support practices.

description:

We are seeking an experienced Applications L2/L3 Support & Maintenance Engineer with expertise in OpenText RightFax to provide operational support, administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and minor enhancements for enterprise faxing solutions. Application Support & Operations
  
  

* Provide L2/L3 support for RightFax applications and related faxing services.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, service requests, and production issues within SLA timelines.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
* Monitor application performance, fax queues, integrations, and system health proactively.
* Support day-to-day RightFax administration and operational activities.

Application Maintenance
  
  

* Perform routine maintenance activities including patch validation, upgrades, configuration reviews, and system optimization.

* Manage application health checks and ensure optimal system performance.
