* Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and change requests using ITSM tools.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, database, network, and security teams for issue resolution.
* Participate in production releases and change implementation activities.
* Support disaster recovery, failover testing, and business continuity activities.

User & Access Administration
  
  

* Create, modify, disable, and manage RightFax user accounts and fax numbers.
* Support access requests, role management, routing configurations, and mailbox management.
* Maintain user profiles, distribution lists, and fax routing configurations.

Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination
  
  

* Act as the primary liaison with OpenText/RightFax vendor support for complex issues.
* Coordinate troubleshooting efforts between business users, infrastructure teams, and external vendors.
* Track vendor cases through resolution and communicate status updates to stakeholders.

Documentation & Compliance
  
  

* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, knowledge articles, and support documentation.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security, audit, and data governance policies.
* Support audit requests and maintain operational records.

**Technical Skills Required**

* Strong experience supporting OpenText RightFax environments.
* Experience with:
* RightFax Enterprise Manager
* Fax Server Administration
* Fax Routing & DID Configurations
* RightFax Integrations
* Fax Queue Monitoring
* User Administration
* Knowledge of:
* Windows Server Administration
* IIS
* Active Directory
* SQL Server
* SMTP/Email Systems (Exchange/O365)
* Networking fundamentals
* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of application monitoring and alert management tools.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience supporting RightFax integrations with ERP, EMR/EHR, Document Management, or Enterprise Applications.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation using PowerShell.
* Knowledge of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
* Vendor management experience.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 5+ years of application support experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on RightFax administration and support experience.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Healthcare enterprise support experience.
* OpenText RightFax certifications.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise faxing environments.

**Senior Support Engineer**
Insurity’s next Senior Support Engineer will be a hands-on, customer-focused technical support professional who owns and coordinates the investigation and resolution of medium- to high-complexity production issues across assigned Insurity products.
  
  
This role combines advanced ticket ownership and escalation judgment with product configuration, component and integration knowledge, technical troubleshooting, and functional and technical root-cause analysis. The ideal candidate communicates clearly, documents work accurately, mentors other support engineers and performs effective handoffs to help customers and internal teams reach timely resolutions.
  
  
This role is expected to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours and support customer-facing production issues across applicable time zones when required
  
  
**What Our Senior Support Engineer**
**Will Do**

* Lead triage of incoming tickets, determine priority and ownership, identify billable work, and act as an escalation point for higher-priority or complex support issues.
* Own medium- to high-complexity customer issues and requests through investigation, coordination, communication, resolution, and documented closure.
* Use SQL or similar query tools, application and platform logs, troubleshooting tools, debugging utilities, and other diagnostic methods to investigate reported issues and validate findings.
* Use Kubernetes and GitOps workflows to monitor deployments, review operational behavior, and support investigation of production issues.
* Apply advanced product configuration knowledge to troubleshoot core components, workflows, business rules, transaction processing, and integrations.
* Use programming logic, such as PHP, C#, PowerBuilder, Angular, TypeScript, etc. knowledge to investigate defects, gather relevant evidence, and communicate findings for further resolution.
* Perform functional and technical root-cause analysis for complex incidents and present findings, impact, contributing factors, and recommended actions clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Perform technical troubleshooting across connected systems and identify whether an issue is caused by a defect, configuration gap, integration behavior, data condition, or support process.
* Execute or coordinate approved data-maintenance scripts, quality audits, and other support-related technical work with the appropriate teams.
* Escalate issues through established procedures, provide complete technical context, and maintain follow-up through resolution or transition to the appropriate owner.
* Maintain accurate ticket information, workflow systems, customer-facing tools, case records, resolution notes, impact assessments, and knowledge-based content with limited oversight.
* Support customer-facing production issues through clear written and verbal communication, coordination across multiple time zones, and effective handoffs that protect business continuity.
* Support new customer go-lives by following established readiness processes, completing assigned tasks, and coordinating risks or dependencies with the appropriate teams.
* Communicate with Product Management, Software Engineering, Professional Services, other internal teams, and third-party software suppliers or partners as needed.
* Provide self-service tool support and ad hoc training for customers, internal users, new employees, and other support team members.
* Mentor Support Engineers and provide practical guidance on troubleshooting, ticket ownership, documentation, escalation judgment, and customer communication.
* Support continuous-improvement initiatives that reduce low-value support demand, improve service quality, strengthen knowledge transfer, and increase customer self-service.
* Contribute to and improve knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, standard procedures, and other documentation used for training and operational consistency.
* Use AI tools, where appropriate and consistent with company requirements, to support troubleshooting, research, analysis, and documentation.
* Stay current on industry and job-related trends, support best practices, Insurity product changes, and new products offered.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in a support, development, or consulting environment, including at least 3 years supporting or developing assigned products.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.
* Experience owning complex customer issues, leading escalations, performing functional and technical root-cause analysis, and coordinating work across technical teams.
* Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to less-experienced support engineers.
* Advanced analytical and critical-thinking skills, creative problem solving, and strong technical judgment.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings accurately, manage expectations, document work, and perform effective handoffs.
* Strong time-management, planning, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing customer needs.
* Ability to collaborate effectively while also working independently and taking ownership of assigned work.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to customer and team support needs.
* Strong business and technical acumen, including software development acumen and programming logic.
* Advanced technical troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, data, and integrations.
* Ability to configure the product and understand component and integration interactions.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office or similar productivity tools, SQL or similar query tools, XML/JSON or similar data formats, databases, version-control systems, case-management or CRM systems, debug utilities, application logs, and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and Jira, Kubernetes, GitOps workflows, web-based troubleshooting tools, and PHP-based defect investigation is preferred.
* Working knowledge of insurance workflows, supported business scenarios, customer variations, and Insurity products is preferred.
* Within the first three months, complete required Insurity Academy courses and product-specific training covering company learning requirements, insurance and domain concepts, product functions, workflow and process training, transaction workflows, and technical processing.

description:

Job Title : Senior System & Network Administrator (IT Hardware & Network)

Experience : 7–10 years
  
  
Location : Partapur, Delhi Road, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh
  
  
Working Hours : 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
  
  
Certification : Cisco CCNA
  
  
Reporting To : General Manager – Platform Engineering
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking a highly experienced and capable Senior System & Network Administrator with at least 7 years of hands-on experience in managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network security, server administration, and IT facility management.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and reliability of the organization's IT infrastructure while minimizing operational downtime.
  
  
As a key member of the IT Infrastructure & Facility Management function, the candidate will oversee enterprise networks, Windows and Linux servers, security systems, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, IT procurement, asset management, and end-user support. The role will also involve managing vendor relationships, software licenses, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and infrastructure performance reporting.
  
  
Experience in a manufacturing environment will be an added advantage, particularly in supporting plant operations, business-critical systems, and uninterrupted IT services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise networks, including Cisco routers, switches, VLANs, and network segmentation.
* Manage firewalls, Unified Threat Management (UTM) security features, NAT/PAT configurations, and secure VPN connectivity for site-to-site and remote access.
* Administer endpoint security solutions, including Sequrite Endpoint Protection, and maintain awareness of EDR, XDR, and MDR security technologies.
* Manage Windows Server and Linux systems, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, DHCP, proxy servers, and virtualization infrastructure.
* Plan and execute server upgrades, firmware and BIOS updates, operating system patching, and end-of-life hardware replacements.
* Maintain reliable backup and recovery processes, periodically verify backup integrity, and support infrastructure continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Manage Microsoft 365/Office 365 or Google Workspace environments, including user accounts, access controls, and identity management.
* Monitor network and server performance using enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Nagios, proactively identifying and resolving infrastructure issues.
* Analyze system logs, network traffic, and security events to identify faults, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions.
* Support the installation, configuration, and maintenance of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) and MySQL databases, including basic queries, database maintenance, and user access management.
* Manage IT assets, endpoint compliance, hardware and software inventories, device security policies, and asset lifecycle tracking.
* Oversee IT facility infrastructure, including IP-based CCTV surveillance, biometric attendance systems, and associated physical security technologies.
* Plan IT budgets, evaluate hardware and software requirements, assess vendors, negotiate commercial terms, and manage procurement activities.
* Oversee annual renewals of AMCs, software licenses, application subscriptions, and infrastructure support contracts.
* Manage IT helpdesk operations and ticketing workflows, ensuring timely resolution of user issues in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain up-to-date network diagrams, infrastructure documentation, technical inventories, troubleshooting guides, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports covering network performance, server downtime, helpdesk tickets, user complaints, security incidents, and hardware ageing.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable IT services and continuous infrastructure improvement.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches, firewall administration, UTM, NAT/PAT, and VPN configurations.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Linux administration.
* Experience with virtualization technologies, server hardware, storage, system patching, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of endpoint protection solutions, security policies, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience in implementing and monitoring backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365/Office 365 or Google Workspace administration and identity management.
* Working knowledge of network and infrastructure monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Nagios.
* Basic administration of MSSQL and MySQL databases, including queries, maintenance, and access controls.
* Experience in IT asset management, hardware and software procurement, vendor coordination, AMC management, and license renewals.
* Knowledge of helpdesk ticketing systems, SLA management, IT documentation, and MIS reporting.
* Familiarity with IP-based CCTV, biometric access control or attendance systems, and related IT facility infrastructure.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* A high degree of ownership and accountability for infrastructure availability and service continuity.
* Ability to prioritize incidents and resolve issues under time-sensitive conditions.
* Good communication and coordination skills when working with users, vendors, and management.
* Strong planning, documentation, reporting, and IT asset management capabilities.
* Ability to independently manage multiple infrastructure activities and lead technical service delivery.
* A cost-conscious approach to procurement, vendor management, and infrastructure optimization.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Experience in IT infrastructure management within a manufacturing or plant-based environment.
* Exposure to production-critical applications, ERP systems, and business operations.
* Experience with remote deployment and automation of firmware, BIOS, and operating system updates.
* Experience in IT budget planning, commercial negotiations, vendor evaluation, and annual contract management.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with high-availability infrastructure, production clustering, and server modernization.
* Familiarity with EDR, XDR, MDR, and advanced threat detection and response practices.
* Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) practices, incident management, change management, and SLA governance.
* Exposure to infrastructure security audits, business continuity planning, and disaster recovery drills.

**Proximity to Delhi-NCR**
**Approximate Distances**

* Delhi: 70 km
* Ghaziabad: 40 km
* Noida: 55 km

**Connectivity**

* Road: Access via NH-58 and the Delhi–Meerut Expressway.
* Rail: Railway connectivity to Delhi and surrounding areas.
* Metro/Rapid Rail: Connectivity through the Delhi Metro and the Namo Bharat (RRTS) network, subject to the selected route and station.

Cost Advantage: Meerut offers a comparatively lower cost of living than Delhi and Noida, making it an attractive location for professionals seeking affordable accommodation and living expenses.

title: MQ Admin
description:
Job description:

Job Role – MQ Administrator

Position Title-MQ Administrator / Middleware Administrator

Location-As per project/business requirements

Salary: 50,000 to 70,000 Per Month

Experience-2-5

Employment Type-Full-Time

About the Company

We are a leading aviation IT solutions provider specializing in mission-critical airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, operational technology platforms, and digital transformation solutions for airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects involve complex, high-availability environments requiring secure, scalable, and resilient system integrations across multiple airport operational systems.

We are seeking a highly skilled MQ Administrator to manage, optimize, and support enterprise messaging and middleware infrastructure in demanding, 24x7 operational environments.

Role Overview

The MQ Administrator will be responsible for the installation, configuration, administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, security, and performance optimization of enterprise messaging systems, primarily IBM MQ and related middleware technologies. The role requires strong expertise in high-availability messaging architecture, integration support, incident management, and coordination with application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and operations teams.

The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, operational discipline, proactive problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to work effectively in high-pressure, mission-critical aviation environments.

Key Responsibilities

Middleware & MQ Administration

* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain IBM MQ environments across development, testing, staging, and production systems.
* Create and manage Queue Managers, Queues, Channels, Listeners, Clusters, Topics, and security configurations.
* Configure and support distributed MQ environments across Linux, Windows, and cloud platforms.
* Manage MQ clustering, multi-instance queue managers, failover configurations, and high-availability setups.
* Perform routine health checks and preventive maintenance activities.
* Monitor queue depth, channel status, message flow, and overall middleware performance.
* Troubleshoot messaging failures, connectivity issues, latency problems, and application integration incidents.
* Support SSL/TLS configurations, certificate management, and secure messaging practices.
* Implement backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures for middleware environments.
* Maintain middleware standards, naming conventions, and operational procedures.



System Integration Support

* Coordinate with application teams, system integrators, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams during deployments and integrations.
* Support airport operational systems integrations involving mission-critical applications.
* Assist in interface troubleshooting between enterprise systems, operational databases, APIs, and third-party applications.
* Analyze message flow logs and transaction traces for issue resolution.
* Support SIT, UAT, production rollout, and cutover activities.



Monitoring & Incident Management

* Provide L2/L3 support for production middleware incidents.
* Participate in 24x7 operational support and on-call rotations when required.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with SLA, availability, and operational KPIs.
* Maintain incident records, operational logs, and technical documentation.



Security & Compliance

* Ensure middleware infrastructure complies with organizational cybersecurity policies.
* Implement authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging mechanisms.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security audits, and compliance activities.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity teams for hardening and risk mitigation.



Automation & Optimization

* Develop and maintain automation scripts for monitoring, deployment, backup, and maintenance activities.
* Identify opportunities for performance tuning and operational improvements.
* Support infrastructure modernization and cloud migration initiatives where applicable.



Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in IBM MQ Administration.
* Strong experience in enterprise middleware administration in production environments.
* Experience working on Linux and Windows server environments.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, networking, firewall concepts, and secure communication protocols.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery configurations.
* Knowledge of shell scripting or automation scripting.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident and change management processes.



Preferred Skills

* Experience in aviation, airport systems, transportation, or mission-critical environments.
* Knowledge of IBM ACE/IIB, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or other messaging platforms.
* Experience with containerized or cloud-based middleware deployments.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, AppDynamics, Splunk, or similar.
* Understanding of APIs, REST/SOAP integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience supporting large-scale system integration projects.
* Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices.

Desired Behavioral Competencies

* Strong ownership and accountability mindset.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure in 24x7 operational environments.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* High attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Proactive problem-solving approach.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and multicultural teams.
* Strong documentation and reporting capabilities.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and project requirements.

Working Conditions

* May require shift support and participation in on-call rotations.
* May involve support during production cutovers, migrations, and critical operational activities.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on large-scale international aviation and airport technology projects.
* Exposure to mission-critical enterprise systems and integrations.
* Collaborative and technology-driven work environment.
* Career growth opportunities in enterprise integration and middleware technologies.
* Competitive compensation and professional development opportunities.

Application Process

Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with relevant project experience, certifications, and current notice period details.

 vGics Global enables enterprises worldwide to grow securely through customized Cloud Services, Managed IT Infrastructure, and comprehensive Cybersecurity \& Compliance solutions. The company focuses on scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective IT environments that meet stringent regulatory requirements and deliver measurable business impact. With over 70 years of combined experience and certifications from Microsoft, AWS, Citrix, and ISACA, the team brings strong technical depth and a practical, problem\-solving mindset to every engagement. vGics Global partners with organizations to not only implement technology, but also to innovate, optimize, and safeguard critical systems. Prospective team members can explore verified client feedback to understand the company’s impact and reputation in the market.
   

**Role Description** 
 The System Engineer will work full time on\-site at the vGics Global office in Noida, focusing on the design, implementation, and maintenance of secure and scalable IT systems. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include configuring and administering servers and networked systems, monitoring performance, and ensuring high availability and reliability of infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues, coordinating with cross\-functional teams to resolve incidents, and providing technical support to internal and external stakeholders. The System Engineer will contribute to systems design and improvement projects, assist in implementing cybersecurity and compliance controls, and document configurations, procedures, and best practices. This position requires a hands\-on, detail\-oriented approach and a commitment to maintaining resilient, future\-ready IT environments.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Systems Engineering and Systems Design skills for planning, architecting, and optimizing IT infrastructure.
* Candidates should possess System Administration skills for managing servers, operating systems, and core services in production environments.
* Candidates should possess Troubleshooting and Technical Support skills for diagnosing issues, resolving incidents, and assisting users effectively.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of networking fundamentals, cloud platforms (such as AWS or Azure), and cybersecurity best practices.
* Relevant academic background in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., Microsoft, AWS, networking, or security) are an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Noida, collaborate with diverse teams, communicate clearly, and document technical work thoroughly.
* Experience with monitoring tools, backup and disaster recovery, and compliance\-driven environments is beneficial.

title: Patch/Deployment Management
description:
**Req ID:** 
 373588
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Patch/Deployment Management to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 Role Overview Patch Management \& Software Deployment is a senior hands\-on technical role within NTT DATA's Enterprise Endpoint Management (EPM) practice. This individual owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of enterprise patch management and software deployment operations across Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune for one or more enterprise client accounts.
   

  

 At Grade 9, the engineer operates with a high degree of independence on complex patching and deployment challenges, serves as the L3 escalation point for patch and software deployment issues within the team, and actively contributes to process governance, automation, and junior team development. The role is critical to client patch compliance posture, vulnerability remediation SLA adherence, and software lifecycle discipline across large, diverse endpoint estates.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Patch Management – SCCM / MECM**
* Design and govern the end\-to\-end software update management lifecycle in SCCM — from SUP synchronisation through ADR execution, deployment targeting, and compliance reporting.
* Architect and maintain WSUS topology — upstream/downstream server configuration, product and classification scoping, synchronisation schedules, and cleanup routines.
* Build and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for Patch Tuesday, out\-of\-band, and zero\-day update scenarios across tiered deployment ring strategies.
* Define and enforce maintenance window frameworks across server, workstation, and critical asset device collections aligned to client change management policies.
* Manage phased patch deployment pipelines — Pilot, UAT, and Production ring progressions with dwell periods and compliance gates.
* Monitor patch compliance dashboards and produce client\-facing SLA compliance reports; drive remediation for non\-compliant devices.
* Govern Software Update Point (SUP) health — synchronisation failures, WSUS certificate management, expired update cleanup, and IIS health monitoring.
* Manage third\-party patch management integration within SCCM where applicable — SCUP, or third\-party update catalogue publishing.
* Lead post\-patch validation activities — confirming deployment success, identifying failed devices, and driving re\-deployment or manual remediation workflows.


**Patch Management – Microsoft Intune / Windows Update for Business**
* Design and manage Windows Update for Business (WUfB) update ring policies in Intune for Quality Updates, Feature Updates, and driver update management.
* Configure and maintain Feature Update policies and Windows 11 readiness targeting for Intune\-managed device populations.
* Govern Intune update compliance reporting — identify deferred, failed, and non\-compliant devices and drive resolution within SLA.
* Manage Expedite Update workflows in Intune for emergency/zero\-day patch scenarios requiring accelerated deployment.
* Align Intune update ring configurations with SCCM co\-management patch workload authority assignments to prevent policy conflicts.
* Support Windows Autopatch readiness assessment and onboarding activities for eligible client environments.


**Software Deployment – SCCM / MECM**
* Lead application and software deployment design in SCCM — MSI, MSIX, EXE, and script\-based deployments with accurate detection rules, supersedence chains, and dependency modelling.
* Build and manage SCCM deployment types, requirement rules, and global conditions for complex multi\-platform application targeting.
* Design and govern phased deployment pipelines for critical software rollouts — piloting, staged production expansion, and rollback capability.
* Manage SCCM application catalogue health, deployment monitoring, and failed deployment investigation across client device estates.
* Govern SCCM Distribution Point (DP) content management — content pre\-staging, validation, redistribution, and bandwidth throttling for remote site deployments.
* Lead software lifecycle management within SCCM — application versioning, supersedence, retirement, and catalogue hygiene.
* Support Software Metering configuration for licence compliance monitoring and usage reporting.


**Software Deployment – Microsoft Intune**
* Build and manage Win32 application deployments in Intune — IntuneWinAppUtil packaging, detection rules, requirement rules, and dependency targeting.
* Manage LOB app, Microsoft Store for Business, and MSIX package deployments in Intune with appropriate assignment targeting.
* Govern app deployment monitoring and remediation — resolve installation failures, assignment conflicts, and detection rule mismatches.
* Manage Intune app supersedence and update workflows for deployed Win32 and LOB applications.
* Support PowerShell script and remediation deployment via Intune for configuration enforcement and break\-fix automation.


**Compliance Reporting \& Vulnerability Remediation**
* Produce and maintain patch compliance dashboards in SCCM SSRS, Power BI, or equivalent reporting tooling for client account review.
* Integrate patch compliance data with vulnerability management outputs (Qualys, Tenable, Defender Vulnerability Management) to drive prioritised remediation workflows.
* Maintain SLA compliance tracking for patch deployment targets — Critical, High, Medium, and Low severity update timelines.
* Lead monthly patch reporting packs for client QSR (Quarterly Service Review) inputs and governance reporting.
* Identify systemic compliance failures — analyse root causes (hardware, connectivity, agent health, exclusions) and drive permanent fixes.


**Automation \& Scripting**
* Develop and maintain PowerShell automation for SCCM patch operations — ADR management, collection membership, compliance queries, and remediation scripts.
* Build Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune patch compliance reporting, update ring management, and bulk device operations.
* Automate WSUS maintenance routines — expired update decline, computer cleanup, and synchronisation health monitoring.
* Create PowerShell\-based deployment health check scripts for post\-patch and post\-deployment validation.


**Documentation, Governance \& Mentoring**
* Author and maintain patch management SOPs, runbooks, deployment playbooks, and maintenance window calendars.
* Represent patch and deployment changes in the client CAB (Change Advisory Board) process — RFC preparation and impact assessment.
* Provide L3 technical guidance and mentoring to Grade 7 and Grade 8 engineers on patch and software deployment operations.
* Conduct peer reviews of deployment configurations, ADR setups, and compliance reporting produced by junior team members.
* Contribute to EPM practice knowledge base, lessons learned documentation, and internal technical communities.


**Required Skills**
**SCCM / MECM – Patch \& Deployment**
* SCCM Current Branch – Software Update Management: SUP, WSUS, ADR, Maintenance Windows, Phased Deployments (advanced level)
* Application deployment – MSI/MSIX/EXE, detection rules, supersedence, dependency modelling, phased rollout
* Distribution Point management – content prestaging, bandwidth throttling, remote DP operations
* SCCM reporting – SSRS built\-in reports, custom compliance queries, WQL collection queries
* Third\-party patch integration – SCUP or third\-party catalogue publishing experience (desirable)
* Co\-management – patch workload authority, Intune/SCCM policy conflict avoidance


**Microsoft Intune – Patch \& Deployment**
* Windows Update for Business (WUfB) – update rings, Feature Update policies, driver management, expedite workflows
* Win32 app packaging and deployment – IntuneWinAppUtil, detection rules, requirement rules, dependency
* Intune compliance and update reporting – built\-in reports, Graph API\-based custom reporting
* Remediation scripts and PowerShell deployment via Intune
* Intune co\-management alignment – patch workload and policy authority coordination with SCCM


**Vulnerability \& Compliance Integration**
* Integration of patch compliance with vulnerability management tools – Qualys VMDR, Tenable, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management
* SLA\-based patch compliance tracking and executive reporting
* Power BI or SSRS for patch compliance dashboard development


**Scripting \& Automation**
* PowerShell – advanced scripting for SCCM patch operations, WSUS maintenance, Intune automation
* Microsoft Graph API – Intune patch compliance, update ring management, bulk device operations
* WMI/CIM – SCCM device collection queries, patch state interrogation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\) – held or in progress
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
* ITIL v4 Foundation
* Experience with Windows Autopatch assessment and onboarding
* Familiarity with SCCM CMG (Cloud Management Gateway) for internet\-based patch management
* Exposure to Qualys VMDR, Tenable.io, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management integration with SCCM/Intune
* Prior experience delivering patch compliance in regulated environments — ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOX, or PCI\-DSS


 Experience Profile
   

  

* 9–12 years of progressive experience in enterprise endpoint management.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on SCCM/MECM Software Update Management and application deployment experience.
* Minimum 2 years of Microsoft Intune WUfB and Win32 application deployment experience.
* Proven track record managing patch compliance across multi\-site enterprise estates of 5,000\+ endpoints.
* Experience working in managed services, IT outsourcing, or large enterprise IT delivery models preferred.


 Minimum Education
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* MCA or equivalent postgraduate qualification considered with commensurate experience.

**Role Objective** 




 Provide senior\-level operational support across Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints and enterprise applications, with practical hands\-on exposure to Azure administration and Entra ID services. The engineer will take end\-to\-end ownership of difficult Tier 2/3 cases, act as the primary technical authority for Intune and PagerDuty and build durable documentation that enables continuity of service in a distributed support model.
 



**Core Responsibilities** 



* Own complex incidents from initial engagement through diagnosis, stakeholder communication, remediation, validation and closure; manage multiple priorities without compromising customer experience.
* Administer Active Directory and Entra ID, including users, groups, OUs, GPO troubleshooting, authentication, MFA, synchronization, access lifecycle, security\-group based permissions and hybrid identity integration with Azure.
* Support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, groups, shared mailboxes, licensing and collaboration\-related access issues.
* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, architecture/operational notes, support knowledge articles, configuration standards, inventories, troubleshooting guides, and handover documentation.
* Partner with Security, application owners, vendors and service teams; provide complete diagnostics and recommendations for high\-complexity or business\-impacting issues.



**Specialist Capability Requirements** 




**Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Management \| SME / Expert** 



* Own Intune administration for Windows endpoints, including enrollment, compliance, configuration profiles, application deployment, update rings, endpoint security policies and troubleshooting.
* Investigate device registration, policy assignment, application installation, Autopilot, certificate, conditional access and endpoint compliance issues; drive root\-cause resolution.
* Maintain endpoint management standards, deployment documentation, exception records and operational reporting.



**PagerDuty Administration and Operations \| SME / Expert** 



* Administer services, escalation policies, schedules, on\-call rotations, integrations, event routing, notification rules and user access.
* Troubleshoot alert delivery and integration failures; tune routing and escalation to reduce missed or noisy alerts and support reliable incident response.
* Maintain PagerDuty configuration, ownership maps, support procedures and audit\-ready documentation.



**End User Support and Customer Service \| Expert** 



* Provide Tier 2/3 support for Windows endpoints and enterprise applications, including internal employees and external consultants accessing client environments such as Epic and customer\-specific applications.
* Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, networking, authentication, profile, application and endpoint issues independently.
* Explain technical issues and solutions clearly to technical and non\-technical users while maintaining strong ownership and customer service.



**Printer Administration and Vendor Management \| Intermediate** 



* Serve as primary technical contact for managed print services and coordinate replacements, repairs and escalations with COBB or the designated print vendor.
* Troubleshoot printer deployment, connectivity, drivers, queues, mappings and end\-user printing; maintain inventory and lifecycle documentation.



**File Services and Collaboration Administration \| Intermediate** 



* Create, modify and troubleshoot SMB file shares, NTFS permissions and Active Directory security groups; resolve user access and permission issues.
* Assist with migration of legacy shares to SharePoint Online, OneDrive or Azure Files; document share structures and recommend modernization improvements.
* Work with authorized US\-based teams and Geo team data in accordance with access, privacy and security requirements.



**Azure Administration and Cloud Operations \| Working / Good Hands\-on** 



* Perform day\-to\-day Azure administration activities through the Azure Portal, including resource groups, subscriptions, virtual machines, storage accounts and basic network configuration.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity operations, including user and group administration, role assignments, MFA, Conditional Access awareness, access reviews and troubleshooting of directory synchronization.

* Working knowledge of PowerShell, Azure Portal, Azure Resource Groups, virtual machines, storage accounts, networking fundamentals, RBAC, monitoring, endpoint networking, authentication, application troubleshooting, SMB/NTFS permissions and cloud collaboration platforms.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, customer service, prioritization, analytical troubleshooting, and technical documentation skills.

title: IT Applications Engineer - Technology IT
description:
**About Signant Health** 




 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



  





 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 The
 **IT Applications Engineer** 
 is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function** 



* Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
* Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
* Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
* Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
* Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
* Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
* Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
* Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
* Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
* AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
* Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 




**Essential:** 



* NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
* Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
* Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
* APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
* Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
* Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
* ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.



  





**Desirable:** 



* Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
* Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
* Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
* Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.



  





**Why Signant Health?** 




 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
 



  





 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
 



  





 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
 



  





 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
 



  





 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.

* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery

title: Production Support Engineer
description:
We are hiring in Noida, India Only.
   

  

**About Ampliwork, Inc**
 Ampliwork builds Enterprise\-Grade AI Agents that amplify Human Potential™ to drive
   

  

 business productivity and growth since 2017\. Ampliwork’s AI Agents streamline complex
   

  

 multi\-step workflows in highly regulated industries such as Financial Services.
   

  

 Ampliwork builds and runs AI platforms for enterprise clients. Those platforms are in production, and the people using them need a reliable place to take questions, issues and requests. This is a new role, and it owns that first line of response.
   

  

 You take everything that arrives from client users, resolve what can be resolved, investigate what needs investigating, and pass to engineering only the items that genuinely require an engineer, complete and reproduced. Most of what comes in should be closed by you.
   

  

 The role covers several client deployments. Volumes vary by account and by week, so holding multiple contexts at once and prioritising sensibly across them is a central part of the job. Response and resolution targets are agreed with each client and vary by severity. We will walk through how that works at interview.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
****First response and first\-line resolution****
* Own the support queue end to end: acknowledge new requests promptly, classify them by severity, and drive every item to resolution or to a complete handoff.
* Answer usage and configuration questions directly, from the documentation and your own understanding of the product. A large share of inbound volume is not a defect: there are questions, workflow misunderstandings, enhancement ideas, and reports that turn out to be working as designed. Resolving those yourself is one of the main contributions of the role.
* Where the system behaviour is expected, walk the user through the correct workflow and close the loop with them. Where it is a defect, confirm that properly before escalating.
* Go back to the requester for whatever is missing, including screenshots, record references, steps to reproduce, timestamps and environment detail.


 Technical investigation and triage
   

  

* Carry out first\-level technical triage: inspect application and cloud logs, run read\-only database queries, reproduce the reported behaviour, and form your own view of the likely cause.
* Read application code well enough to locate the relevant logic and confirm or rule out a hypothesis.
* Work each ticket from more than one angle before drawing a conclusion, and recognise when you have reached the limit of what you can resolve on your own.
* Treat our internal AI triage tooling as a starting point rather than an answer. Check its classification and its suggested cause, correct it where it is wrong, and add your own findings.


**Escalation And Follow\-through**
* Escalate only the tickets that need it, with a reproducible case, logs, affected records, environment detail and your own analysis attached.
* Create and own the tasks sent downstream to the engineering team, then follow them through fix, review and release, and verify in production.
* Push back where a request sits outside agreed scope, and route it as an enhancement rather than letting it enter the queue as a defect.
* Judge when to ask for help. Flagging early is preferred to spending a day stuck on the same problem.


**Client Communication**
* Act as the named point of contact for client users, over email, the support portal and chat. You will be writing to experienced enterprise users, in some cases daily.
* Keep them informed at an agreed cadence, including regular status updates on high\-severity issues until they are resolved, whether or not there is progress to report.
* Tell clients plainly what is known, what is being done, and when they will next hear from you. Tickets should not go quiet.
* Hold your position courteously when a request is out of scope or a severity label is wrong, and know when to bring colleagues into the conversation.


**Knowledge, Reporting And Improvement**
* Contribute to the knowledge base as you go, covering known issues, workarounds, runbooks and standard responses, so that a repeat occurrence takes less work than the first. The work you do here will contribute directly to the skills of the triage AI Agent.
* Produce a weekly support report for each account, covering volume, mix, response performance, ageing, open high\-severity items and the recurring issues that warrant a permanent fix.
* Surface effort being spent outside agreed scope so that it can be reviewed.
* Give feedback on the triage tooling. Where its classification or draft replies are wrong, explain why, so that it can be improved rather than worked around.


**Essential**
****What we are looking for****
* Three to five years in application support, production support, technical support engineering, or a comparable client\-facing technical role.
* Python. Able to read and debug application code, and write small scripts to inspect data or verify behaviour.
* Cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent). Comfortable navigating logs and monitoring to trace an issue through a running system.
* SQL and PostgreSQL. Able to write your own queries to answer data\-level questions without waiting for someone else.
* A track record of resolving tickets rather than routing them. At interview we will ask you to talk through issues you closed yourself that others might have escalated.
* Excellent written English. Most of your output is writing, and much of it goes directly to a client. You will also regularly be on calls with client users, being able to explain how the system works using vocabulary that is relevant to client, is important.
* Self\-starting and methodical. You take notes, follow up on open items without being prompted, and keep track of everything that is outstanding.
* Comfortable being assertive. The role involves challenging a severity label, declining an out\-of\-scope request, and telling a client that what they are describing is not a defect.
* Able to carry several accounts and unrelated products at the same time, and to switch between them without losing track.
* Able to learn a complex domain application quickly. Our platforms carry substantial business logic, and supporting them well means understanding that logic rather than recognising screens.
* Comfortable being accountable for response times and for the client relationship, not only for ticket counts.


****Desirable****
* Experience working to defined service levels in enterprise, regulated or audited environments.
* Experience with an enterprise ticketing platform and a downstream engineering task tracker.
* Additional languages.
* Exposure to financial services, professional services, insurance, tax or transport operations.
* Experience working alongside AI agents or automation within a support workflow.


**How Success Is Measured**
****Horizon****
**What Good Looks Like**
 First 30 days
   

  

 You own the queue on your first account, acknowledge new requests within the agreed window, and classify severity correctly without help. Requests waiting on missing information are chased and moving.
   

  

 60 days
   

  

 Only the tickets that need an engineer reach engineering, and they arrive complete and reproduced. The weekly support report is running as a standing item, and the knowledge base covers the issues that recur.
   

  

 90 days
   

  

 The same model is running on a second account. You are proposing the product changes that would remove whole categories of ticket, and you own the support process itself, including intake, routing, escalation and client reporting.
   

  

 The headline measure is the proportion of inbound tickets resolved without engineering involvement.
   

  

****Tooling****
 Enterprise ticketing and task tracking, Microsoft 365, AWS (logs, monitoring and managed databases), PostgreSQL, Python, Git, and our internal AI triage tooling.

 Purpose of Role:

 Additionally this role performs as the communication hub for Customer Operations.

* Troubleshooting and sustaining/improving managed service RF and IP network capabilities through the use of various monitoring tools and applications

title: Tower Lead - ServiceNow
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG** 
 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
   

  

 As part of the ASX\-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market\-wide rates, unique added\-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
   

  

**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019\-2011\),** 
 FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time** 
 ! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid\-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
   

  

 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**Summary**
 The ServiceNow Tower Lead is the assistant team leader for the ETS ServiceNow team, responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of ITSM support, project engineering, and platform maintenance, based in the Global Capability Centre. The Tower Lead operates with a high degree of independence, owning solution design and delivery for standard BAU and ITSM work, and coordinating with onshore design leads for major or complex projects where additional design authority is required.
   

  

 Operating within the SIAM framework as part of an internal service provider function, the Tower Lead enables the offshore team to function as a capable, self\-directing delivery unit — maintaining quality, throughput, and platform standards with little routine onshore dependency. The Tower Lead is a senior technical practitioner who leads by example, uplifts team capability, and holds full delivery accountability within the offshore context.
   

  

**Day In The Life**
**Offshore Delivery Leadership**
* Lead and coordinate the offshore ServiceNow development team across BAU support, project delivery, and platform maintenance workstreams.
* Manage daily stand\-ups, sprint ceremonies, and team workflow, driving a high\-performing delivery cadence with minimal onshore direction required.
* Act as the primary escalation point for the development team, resolving blockers and maintaining momentum through active, technically\-grounded leadership.
* Allocate work across the development team based on capacity, skillset, and priority, optimising throughput without compromising quality.
* Foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement within the team, setting clear expectations for delivery standards and individual accountability.


**Solution Design and Technical Authority**
* Own end\-to\-end solution design for all BAU ITSM work and small projects, translating business requirements into well\-defined technical specifications and acceptance criteria without requiring onshore input (except where a Technical Business Analyst is also assigned).
* Engage with internal business customers to understand requirements, conduct discovery, and propose fit\-for\-purpose ServiceNow solutions aligned to platform best practices and FCTG standards.
* For major or complex projects, receive design artefacts and functional specifications from design leads, interpret these accurately, and direct the team in executing against the agreed design.


**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**
**BAU Support Coordination**
* Oversee the offshore team's response to BAU ServiceNow support tickets, ensuring SLA adherence and customer experience standards are maintained independently of onshore involvement.
* Triage incoming support requests, assign to appropriate developers, and track resolution to closure.
* Identify recurring issues or systemic defects and initiate remediation or platform improvement actions within the team's remit, escalating only where broader platform decisions are needed.
* Maintain awareness of platform incidents and manage support team contribution to resolution activities.


**Testing and Release Coordination**
* Oversee the QA function and ensure test plans, test cases, and defect tracking align to agreed acceptance criteria and standards.
* Coordinate release packaging and submission through ETS change management processes, ensuring all governance requirements are met prior to deployment.
* Ensure all release artefacts, documentation, and post\-release validation activities are completed to standard.


**Governance and Reporting**
* Maintain accurate sprint and delivery reporting to support visibility of the team's productivity, quality, and capacity.
* Contribute to standards, documentation, and knowledge base maintenance in Confluence, ServiceNow and Sharepoint.
* Adhere to change management, release, and governance processes as defined by FCTG, ensuring relevant activity is auditable and compliant.


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
   

  

**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**
